name: 20W USB-C Power Adapter
subtitle: White USB-C charger for compatible devices
description: This white 20W USB-C power adapter provides charging for compatible USB-C devices. Its compact design suits home, office, and travel use. The adapter is listed as compatible with iPhone 8 and later, plus selected iPad Pro and iPad Air models.
story: Designed as a simple wall charging solution, this adapter uses a USB-C output and delivers up to 20W of power. Its compact white body is easy to carry between home, work, and travel locations. A compatible charging cable is required and is not included. The supplied product information lists compatibility with iPhone 8 and later, along with selected iPad Pro and iPad Air models, while the USB-C connection also supports charging other compatible devices.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
